title: Esrbespoke marques
description: A tall list of names in very big type (92px on desktop), all pale except one in full ink, with a small square picture at column 9 that stays pinned at a third of the window while the list scrolls past. The row crossing the middle of the window becomes the dark one and the picture crossfades to its own; hovering a row does the same.
notes: the active row follows the scroll with a small JavaScript listener (hydrate: visible); without it the last row stays active
pale rows are the ink at 10%, so it works on any background
one picture per row; empty pictures are muted placeholders
